required.note: Reduces richness of the nafs to contentment — the exact reading Stage 3 corrected in text_uzbek before the adults set. The S block held «нафснинг бойлигидир» correctly, so the drift is internal to the generation, not inherited from the library. A corrected DB row is necessary and not sufficient.

required.note: Latin quote against a Cyrillic body. Eighth occurrence. Fix is to take text_uzbek_cyrillic verbatim, never to transliterate by hand.
Should be «дедилар» — plural respectful. Every prior UZ reel uses it.

optional.note: 'Our Prophet'. Prior UZ reels use «Пайғамбар ﷺ».
Reads as thanking your family. Thanks go to Allah FOR them. Allah is absent from the moral entirely, as in EN and RU.

out_of_scope.note: «оз» (few) voiced as «ўз» (one's own), inverting the sentence. Caught by ear at the narration stage. No text-stage agent can catch this — recorded so a reader comparing against R056's tracker notes does not expect a finding.
